invariants: The declaration, not the chronology, is the coverage evidence: an empty-bodied approval (a good state) never hides a complete declaration on the same head, and a malformed declaration never falls back to an older one.
The newest review's state gates the evidence before any declaration is accepted: GOOD_STATES membership (APPROVED, COMMENTED) — a newest CHANGES_REQUESTED or DISMISSED review rejects coverage.
Every newest-review selection (latest_review verdict selector, declaring_review) breaks submitted_at ties by the later response position, mirroring the API's submission order.
A CHANGES_REQUESTED declaration is deliberately not coverage evidence even when followed by an empty approval on the same head (documented decision on PR #842's review).
doors: .ci/check_coderabbit_review_coverage.py run() — the candidate-head verdict door (newest state gate + declaring pair)
declaring_review / latest_review selectors — the two newest-selection doors the tie fixes close
.ci/tests/test_coderabbit_review_coverage.py — the pin door: 84 tests including the declaring-pair, malformed, CHANGES_REQUESTED/DISMISSED newest, and the two tie families
The gate workflow's poll step (coderabbit-gate.yml from main) — the verdict model this verifier must never contradict

siblingSearch.result: declaring_review (round 12) and latest_review (round 13) were the two max()/stable-sort selections in the verifier; the gate workflow's own poll uses max() over its fetched list but reads the PR head at execution time and its re-run semantics are documented separately (the verifier's comment records the consistency doctrine); defect_knowledge_intake deduplicates by source ID, not by timestamp ordering, so no other member of the family carries the tie flaw.

findings.invariant: The coverage verifier reads the CodeRabbit processed-file declaration from the newest declaring review on the exact candidate head, and every newest-review selection (verdict or declaration) breaks submitted_at ties by the later response position — the API's submission order
